headline: Heredity is inheritance—traits passed from parents to offspring across generations
universal_truth: You inherit more than you realize; understanding inheritance helps you work with it rather than against it
fun_facts: You share 99.9% of your DNA with every other human—the 0.1% creates all our differences
Some traits skip generations—you might express your grandparent's genes more than your parent's
Identical twins have the same DNA but can develop different personalities through different experiences
discussion_questions: What have you inherited—physically, mentally, culturally—from your family?
Which inherited traits serve you and which don't?
What do you want to pass on versus break from?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: You have your mother's eyes. Your father's temper. Your grandmother's laugh. Traits flow down family lines—some obvious, some hidden. Heredity is the lottery you were born into: the genetic and cultural inheritance you didn't choose.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: We inherit a lot—genes, culture, patterns, even trauma. What do we do with inheritance we didn't choose?
cliff.prompt: How should we relate to inheritance?

options.text: Understand your inheritance to work with it—you can't change what you received, but you can influence how it expresses and what you pass on
options.response: Yes. Inheritance sets starting conditions, not destiny. Knowing your tendencies helps you amplify strengths and compensate for weaknesses. Awareness enables agency.
Genetics influences strongly, but environment and choice also shape expression...

q1.title: Multiple Inheritances
q1.script: You inherit genetically, culturally, and experientially. Each layer matters. Your genes, your family's habits, your environment's norms—all shape who you become.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Multiple Inheritances"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Expression vs Possession
q2.script: Having a gene doesn't mean expressing it. Environment, lifestyle, and choice influence whether inherited tendencies manifest. Inheritance is potential, not fate.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Breaking Patterns
q3.script: You can break inherited patterns—both genetic expression and family habits. Awareness is the first step. What you didn't choose, you can still influence. The chain can change with you.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You inherit more than you realize. Understanding inheritance helps you work with it rather than against it—and choose what to pass on.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 265. Tomorrow, we'll explore why everyone's different—genetic variation. Until then, consider what you've inherited and how you relate to it.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Inheritance Mapping - What Did You Receive?
growTrack.activity: Map your inheritance: physical traits, personality tendencies, cultural patterns, family habits. Which serve you? Which challenge you? Which will you consciously continue or break? Awareness enables choice.
